slides.title: Green flags *nobody talks about*
slides.sub: The quiet ones. The ones that matter most.

slides.title: They remember *the small things.*
slides.body: Something you mentioned once, months ago. They kept it.

slides.title: They’re kind to *everyone.*
slides.body: Waiters, strangers, your mum. Especially your mum.

slides.title: They *hype you up* to their friends.
slides.body: You hear about it later, and it’s glowing.

slides.title: They make room for *your bad days.*
slides.body: No fixing, no rushing. Just staying.

slides.title: They’re curious about *your hobbies.*
slides.body: Even the weird ones. Especially the weird ones.

slides.title: Save this *as your standard.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who checks every box.
